source: User-supplied BeatStream 最終鬼畜妹フランドール・S BEAST Lv10 PERFECT recording (640x360, 29.97 fps)
judgmentRules: Score adds 1e6/724 per judgment. Holds are judged on release; a STREAM is one judgment whose score ramps over its nodes (combo rises per node, hence 740 combo for 724 judgments).
method: Lane kymographs (854x480 resample, 8 radial lanes) tracked at a constant 301 px/s; per-lane arrival phases were snapped to the 200 BPM sixteenth grid and the global sixteenth was fixed by recorded hit sounds and the clean MP3 onsets. Holds come from continuous ribbon occupancy; square swipe notes merge their two edge tracks. Ripples come from hit bursts at the six fixed circles plus green-core closing flashes not explained by squares crossing the circle. A per-frame SCORE reader (whole-number decoding, 3/8 continuity fix) audits counts: ripple times were moved onto unexplained score steps when a ripple was within 0.35 s, and every unmatched candidate was checked in cropped frames (rejections listed below). Streams end at the snapped score-ramp end; paths were measured from frames.
unresolved: 4 cabinet judgments (724 vs 720) have no confident visual note; none were invented.
